title: IT Executive
job_description:
Minimum 2 years of relevant working experience . Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering , or a related field. Basic understanding of programming fundamentals (e.g. OOP, data structures, algorithms). Exposure (academic, project, or internship) to at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, or C# . Familiarity with version control tools (e.g. Git ). Good problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. Good communication skills in English (Bahasa Malaysia is a plus). Willingness to learn, accept feedback, and adapt in a fast-paced environment. Able to work well in a team and independently when required.

Write, test, and debug code for new features and enhancements in web and mobile applications. Maintain and support existing applications by fixing bugs, performing updates, and ensuring performance. Collaborate with UI/UX, QA, and operations teams to ensure quality and smooth deployment. Assist with documentation, including code comments, user guides, and technical specifications. Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices. Support application integrations (e.g. APIs) and basic database tasks. Provide occasional technical support and troubleshooting when needed. Continuously learn new tools, technologies, and development practices.
